input: Prepare me for a meeting with Monday.com (monday.com)

challenges.evidence: monday.com initiated a plan to reduce approximately 20% of its workforce, estimated $45–$55 million in net charges, and said the plan was intended to create a leaner AI-focused operating model.
challenges.challenge: Managing a major workforce and operating-model restructuring

challenges.evidence: Management said customers were moving from buying AI for its own sake to demanding business impact, and described a gap between available technology and actual adoption.
challenges.challenge: Customers are struggling to turn AI purchases into measurable ROI and adoption

challenges.evidence: Management said it would invest most restructuring savings while continuing to scrutinize AI costs and headcount investment and maintain efficiency metrics.
challenges.challenge: Balancing renewed AI investment with cost efficiency

challenges.evidence: Q2 revenue grew 22% year over year, while Q3 guidance called for 16%–17% growth and assumed a negative 100–200 basis-point FX impact.
challenges.challenge: Near-term growth guidance is below the latest reported growth rate and includes FX headwinds

key_people.name: Roy Mann
key_people.title: Co-founder and Co-CEO
key_people.recent: On October 28, he emphasized context, governance, data access, and connecting external agents as enterprise AI differentiators.

key_people.name: Eran Zinman
key_people.title: Co-founder and Co-CEO
key_people.recent: On October 28, he said the main adoption gap was helping customers identify valuable AI use cases and drive organizational change, tying that need to Monday Frontier.

key_people.name: Eliran Glazer
key_people.title: Chief Financial Officer
key_people.recent: On August 10, he said Q2 revenue grew 22% year over year and that record non-GAAP operating income reflected a more focused cost structure.

key_people.name: Casey George
key_people.title: Chief Revenue Officer
key_people.recent: He participated in the October 28 Elevate 2026 management Q&A as the company discussed enterprise AI adoption and go-to-market execution.

key_people.name: Shiran Nawi
key_people.title: Chief People and Legal Officer
key_people.recent: She signed the July 22 restructuring filing, which disclosed the approximately 20% workforce reduction and continued hiring in strategic areas.

priorities.evidence: Management said it committed fully to the AI Work Platform; AI-product ARR doubled from Q1 and represented 17% of net new ARR in Q2.
priorities.priority: Make the AI Work Platform the central product and strategy

priorities.evidence: Customizable AI agents became officially available and were designed to work in existing workflows and boards, with permissions, visibility, and human oversight.
priorities.priority: Drive adoption of customizable AI agents inside existing workflows

priorities.evidence: Management said enterprise customers were adopting AI agents at three times the rate of SMBs and that the strategy was focused on continuing to go upmarket.
priorities.priority: Move further upmarket with enterprise AI deployments

priorities.evidence: Management announced Monday Frontier to help customers identify high-impact AI use cases and deploy them, said it would scale into 2027, and said it would hire for it during 2026 and 2027.
priorities.priority: Scale Monday Frontier, a managed-services and deployment-engineering organization

priorities.evidence: monday.com launched Harmony, a voice AI agent platform for enterprise sales teams, with models for prospecting, qualification, objection handling, and CRM write-back.
priorities.priority: Build specialized AI products for revenue teams

what_they_do.value: monday.com is the AI work platform that not only helps manage and orchestrate work, but also does the work for you.

recent_changes.summary: The company reported $364.6 million of Q2 revenue, said AI-product ARR had doubled from Q1, and described a sharper commitment to the AI Work Platform.
recent_changes.headline: Q2 results and AI pivot

recent_changes.summary: monday.com launched Harmony for mid-market and enterprise customers in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore, targeting AI-supported sales calls and revenue conversion.
recent_changes.headline: Harmony voice AI platform launched

recent_changes.summary: The new organization combines managed services and deployment engineers to help customers implement AI and is expected to scale into 2027.
recent_changes.headline: Monday Frontier announced at Elevate 2026

recent_changes.summary: Leadership emphasized contextual, governed agents and said the platform supports APIs, MCP, headless use, and third-party agents.
recent_changes.headline: Leadership positioned monday.com as an AI agent platform with an open ecosystem

talking_points: Where are customers seeing the biggest gap between buying AI and achieving measurable ROI, and would deployment or services help close it?
How should we think about the balance between monday.com’s native agents, third-party agents, and enterprise governance requirements?
As Monday Frontier scales, which implementation bottlenecks and high-value use cases are the priority for the next two quarters?
